name: p1bg
style: Flat 2D illustration, a wide double-page spread from a children's picture book. {subject} No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only, every colour with a slightly darker flat shade for simple two-tone shading. Bright saturated colours, clean simple shapes. Unbranded, no text, no letters, no numbers.

items.bg: A flat side view of the surface of the Moon like a stage set seen straight from the front with no perspective, with NO spaceships, NO vehicles and NO people: the bottom third of the picture is flat pale grey moon ground with a few shallow round craters and small rocks, running from the left edge to the right edge; above it a deep dark navy blue space sky with many small white and yellow stars, a small blue and green planet Earth in the top right corner and a little ringed planet far away on the left.
